summary: Enhance your skills in Banking and Finance with our comprehensive BI training course. Learn from industry experts and stay ahead of the competition.
lede: Business intelligence for banking and finance equips analysts, risk managers, BI developers and finance leaders to structure and interpret institutional data. The course addresses the practical task of turning banking data into useful reporting and analysis, with work on ETL and data warehouse design, profitability and risk dashboards, customer analysis, fraud monitoring, and predictive models for credit and liquidity.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically designed for professionals who operate at the intersection of financial data, technology, and institutional strategy.
modules: Banking Data Architecture and ETL Foundations
Advanced Analytics and AI in Finance
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial statements and basic banking operations. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel is required; basic SQL knowledge is recommended but not mandatory as foundational concepts will be covered. No prior programming experience is needed for the AI and predictive modules, which are taught at an operational application level.
